newsitem.title: USA: ENVOY to buy Professional Office Systems.
newsitem.headline: ENVOY to buy Professional Office Systems.

text.p: ENVOY Corp said on Tuesday it executed an agreement to acquire Professional Office Systems Inc, the wholly controlled electronic data interchange clearinghouse of Blue Cross Blue Shield for the National Capital Area.
The purchase price for the shares will be approximately $6.4 million in cash and the assumption of certain liabilities, the company said.

In connection with the acquisition, the parties will enter into an exclusive three year outsourcing services agreement for the processing of healthcare electronic data interchange transactions, ENVOY said.
The acquisition, which will be funded through available cash, is subject to usual and customary closing conditions and is expected to close on or before October 31, 1996, the company said.
